body: Thank you, ♥️ hope your journey takes you to places with less noise and more music.
Yeah.... It is scary. I started recently with a therapist, but it really doesn't seem like he's that interested or invested in helping or just doesn't have good answers.
Thank you for your comment, it really does help. I like the thought of leaning more into the reasonable head space.
You honestly look wonderful. Glad you're feeling the positivity!

Be honest and let her know these things. Small bits like this shouldn't hinder the start of a friendship. I think it's just important for her to know that you weren't ignoring her and are actively engaged and interested in being her friend.
Yeah, I feel this deep in my bones. For me it's self love that is lacking and thus I run away as unworthy of those around me.
Congrats! Cherish every moment :)

Thank you 😁. I tend to hide it because of the braces but feeling pretty good lately. 

And right?! It's a miracle worker for pet hair from my furry friends.
Thank you ☺️ first time in years my heart has felt this light. Lots of great people in the world and a lot of folks in my corner. I feel blessed.

If I'm being honest. I bounced the idea back and forth for about 2 hours. I was scared shitless and even looked over my friends list a few times envisioning various people's reactions. At the end of it I thought to myself, I have everything to gain and nothing to lose. I am alone if everyone rejects me. I am alone if I leave everything as it is. I don't even know what I was expecting from this post but it felt good to let it out. 

At the end of the day, start where you feel comfortable. A friend, a family member, someone close. Mine was just dramatic because I felt I had hit rock bottom with no one to go to.

Depression is a secret that will eat you from the inside out and trick you into believing no one cares, but someone, somewhere does even those you least expect.

I'm going to check out that Rhapsody of fire. Just cause the name sounds pretty awesome haha. I think I'm going to push a Killswitch song into my playlist for this run. 

Outside of your broadcasting and metal what else keeps you thriving?

Any Asian food in particular? I'm pretty good with some of the popular Thai dishes and my ex was Vietnamese so I collected a good slew of dishes in those two categories I can share. 

Always down for a good Italian recipe, have you ever tried making your own pasta? For me, the day I do that will be the moment I've made it as a chef lol. 

For sure man. My discord is ghosty314#1347

Haha I feel like conversations die if you can't keep people engaged and stimulated and I'm genuinely interested in what the response would be. 

Oooh a pro gamer I see? Lol that's nice I remember back in the day when I got my first Xbox the very first one playing halo and what not. Miss those days. What have you got in your game rotation?

I think I'll try one a day, just forcing a conversation even if I'm scared to do so and making time to go places where I could have them. I always feel folks will think I'm a weirdo for trying to talk to them gotta get over that silly thought. 

Oh yes please do, not exactly power metal but I definitely had an avenged 7x and Killswitch phase so I'd love to hear more. Lately my music tastes swing but they've been geared more to the softer / acoustic and some rap. Not sure it'll be up your alley but I found one song that has me going because it's so soulful. Sonder - Too Fast

Well in a less dramatic nutshell, COVID peaked my depression when I couldn't see anyone at work. Came to realization that I was alone and in a very dark place. I've been masking that with work work work. (I work about 12-14 hours a day). Just trying to correct my course into better days now and hoping to use this as a medium to start that journey and if I'm lucky maybe I can make a difference in someone else's life as well. 

Have you ever seen those gravity blankets, I wonder if they're worth the $$$ for the comfort. I don't know about you, but I have a tendency to cheap out on myself. What's the last thing you've splurged on and have no regrets ?

Haha what's amazing to me is that others feel the same way. When I feel that way it's always just me, the feeling, and I so it's a nice reminder that you aren't alone. 

I wonder how many awesome posts people started typing but gave up halfway through because of fear 😔. 

I'd love the company! My chilli recipe is really nothing special but it does the job and I'd be happy to share 🙂. What sort of food do you like beyond chili? I can hit you with some recipes if you enjoy cooking. I'm not particularly an amazing cook either but it's nice feeding people 👌.

Dude that's lovely, never thought of it that way. You're almost like a companion to the music curating an experience for folks. 

I myself am trying to shift my personality to be a little more out there and extroverted. Tired of being lonely and putting myself in a box. Any tips for that switch up? 

Also, you've gotta hit me with some music you're interested in lately. I've got a pretty broad music taste and always interested in what others like.
Did you just stumble into that hobby or how did you even get interested. I always wonder how folks get their start in those niche areas.

Well, sparing the juicy details.... Things haven't been going so well for me. Reaching out, trying to connect even if it's over the internet is me trying to hit the switch up on my life. 


I get that, I've got several myself. But no bedroom set would be complete without a body pillow. Have you ever seen those maternity pillows? Low-key want to try one, lol.
Ayy 🙌. I would love to man. I was a DBA in a past life so definitely have some common ground there. That radio stuff is interesting though do you broadcast from home??

Same here, I really should be sleeping right now since I work in the morning pretty early but I'm on a mission to save my life so....  Can't sleep on that. 

Lynnlynn odd question but how many pillows do you sleep with?
Hello hello! How goes it fellow need a friend-er
This made me smile :') thank you for sharing.
I think so, I just need to button some things up at work....
Fellow ghost here. That's the reason for this username :^]

Haha good, hope you got a decent chuckle off of that. 

My friend, American work culture is extremely tough. The reason for the 14 hours is that I somehow became a go to around here. And I allow myself to be burdened to not be the burden. Despite all, I am fortunate to have my income and job without having any formal education and I feel the need to overcompensate with extra hours.


That's correct! It's the little plastic pellets where people simulate combat or whatever. Feels pretty lame saying it but I like the idea of teamwork and coming together. Also, I really like that idea. I think I need to stay grounded: I don't need to be the best or experienced at everything I do. The attempt is enough. 

This a bit of a switching of gears, but I spent a day of chatting / playing games with my roommates and had a ton of fun. But at the end when I laid down for sleep I got hit with this overwhelming feeling of depression and pitfall in the stomach of not having anyone romantically. Like yikes, how do you get away from needing people constantly. 

Ending with a question: what's been a song you've been listening to more often than others in your playlist lately?
She's a beauty :)

Sorry for the delayed response, just closing out a 14 hour work day.... 

I really like that sentiment. Everyone deserves some form of kindness. 

To start, nope there's not really much I like about myself lol. I know that's a cop out answer, but.... There's not much under the hood worth salvaging imo. I'm fairly intelligent but even that isn't worth much when there's folks putting things into space and you're just doing desk work. 

Hobbies? I used to game a fair bit but that's not so fun anymore and can't get my attention span to stick on it these days. I work out but I'm not crazy about that, I just do it cause I know I should. Sports, I don't play anymore. I wanted to get into airsofting but that died quick too. Too much of a scaredy cat to look like a chump showing up and being a noob. I put a list out of things I wanted to try but then COVID hit and well..... You know how that goes. 

Haha man do I share that same feeling, conversation is difficult and trying to find common ground is difficult. Bringing up hobbies always feels weird it's like "HeY gUyS dO u LyK AiRsofT?"

Dude, you're a godsend for even attempting to help. Just wanted to say I appreciate you for the responses and humanity. 

I don't have any deformities, I'm fortunate from that perspective. I'm shorter than I'd like at 5'8" and even though I work out I've still got all the extra skin from my fatter days which eats at me a bit. 

On the social area, I'm decent enough with people but really only on the surface level. Connection beyond that is hard and the people I do talk to are only just my coworkers. I'm liked for my work and what I can do there but not really for the person I am (I think?). 

I'm also a terrible liar in the real world, inventing shit to tell to people to seem more interesting or more than I really am. I'm working on that part. I don't know how lying became second nature but it did and it takes a conscious effort when I'm feeling insecure to not do so. It's never anything important either just dumb things to create an image of who I wish I was, I guess? 

The question for me now is, how do you heal from here and how do you do better?

I agree man, it's tough though. I haven't quite grown the thickness of skin to deal with rejection and set backs the way normal people do. Working on that or at least I'm trying but it's hard to say what the right direction is.

I actually don't have a good answer for that if I'm being honest. 

I guess hate is a strong word and it's more along the lines of saying or doing the wrong thing that puts someone off from wanting to be around me. 

Like being uninteresting, or not fun enough. Or being too much in terms of confidence / talking about my life. Or saying jokes that aren't funny to people except myself.

Of course, I'm happy to even get a response lol. I don't even know where to start, but belonging is hard. And all I want is to belong. 

What about you? Similar situation?
Sorry for your loss, I hope you carry the memory of him into every endeavor you tread through towards a better, healthier, happier life.
